meta.name: systematic-debugging
meta.description: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 遇到报错或测试失败时,按步骤找到真正原因再动手修
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有 bug 或失败的测试,却不知从哪查起
copy.tagline_en: Track down the real cause of an error or failing test before changing code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a bug or failing test leaves you unsure where to start

howto.what: 遇到 bug、测试失败或异常行为时,Claude 会先做根因调查再动代码,依次走根因调查、模式分析、假设与验证、实现修复四个阶段,并先写出失败测试用例。
howto.when: 当你报告任何 bug、测试失败或意外行为并准备修复时接管;作者写明时间紧、看起来简单或反复修不好时也不该跳过。

say.text: 这个测试失败了,先查根因再改
say.note: 会按四阶段流程调查后再提修复

say.text: 生产环境出了个 bug,帮我定位根因
say.note: 先收集证据、定位出错的那一层

say.text: 我已经改了三次还是修不好
say.note: 会停下来质疑架构,而不是再试一次

howto.what_en: When you hit a bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, Claude investigates the root cause before touching code, working through four phases: root cause, pattern analysis, hypothesis and testing, implementation.
howto.when_en: Triggers on any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before fixes are proposed. The author says not to skip it under time pressure, when the fix looks simple, or after repeated failures.

say_en.text: This test is failing. Find the root cause before changing anything.
There's a bug in production, help me locate the root cause.
I've tried three fixes and it's still broken.
